title: the car manufacturer Ferrari enters the Milan Stock Exchange in Piazza Affari with its own share.
text: Ferrari S.p.A. is an Italian luxury sports car manufacturer based in Maranello, Italy. Founded in 1939 by Enzo Ferrari (1898–1988), the company built its first car in 1940, adopted its current name in 1945, and began to produce its current line of road cars in 1947.

title: Murder of Ashley Ann Olsen in Florence
text: Ashley Ann Olsen was an American woman living in Florence, Italy, who was strangled in her apartment in January 2016 by an illegal immigrant from Senegal.

title: 21-24 January: 2015–16 Biathlon World Cup – World Cup 6 in Rasen-Antholz
text: Rasen-Antholz is a municipality in South Tyrol in northern Italy.

title: 12 September - Triennial 2016
text: The Triennial 2016 was the Triennial sanctioned by the Bureau of International Expositions in the Italian city of Milan. Its theme was 21st century.

title: 4-10 April - 2016 IIHF Women's World Championship Division I Group B in Asiago
text: Asiago is a minor township (population roughly 6,500) with the title of city in the surrounding plateau region (the Altopiano di Asiago or Altopiano dei Sette Comuni, Asiago plateau) in the Province of Vicenza in the Veneto region of Northeastern Italy. It is near the border between the Veneto and Trentino-Alto Adige/Südtirol regions in the foothills of the Alps, approximately equidistant (60 km) from Trento to th…

title: 6-29 May: 2016 Giro d'Italia
text: The 2016 Giro d'Italia was the 99th edition of the Giro d'Italia, one of cycling's Grand Tour races. The Giro started in Apeldoorn on 6 May with a 9.8 km individual time trial, followed by two other stages in the Netherlands, both between Nijmegen and Arnhem.

title: the Cirinnà law for same-sex civil unions is approved.
text: Italy has recognised civil unions since 5 June 2016, providing same-sex couples with almost all of the legal protections, benefits and rights of marriage. A bill to this effect was approved by the Senate on 25 February 2016 and by the Chamber of Deputies on 11 May.
wiki: Recognition of same-sex unions in Italy

title: Murder of Sara Di Pietrantonio in Rome
text: The murder of Sara Di Pietrantonio was a femicide that occurred on 29 May 2016 in Rome, Italy. The young woman was stalked and burned alive by her ex-boyfriend Vincenzo Paduano.

title: inauguration of the Gotthard Base Tunnel, the longest high-speed rail tunnel in the world.
text: The Gotthard Base Tunnel is a railway tunnel through the Alps in Switzerland. It opened in June 2016 and full service began the following December.

title: Andria-Corato train collision
text: The Andria–Corato train collision happened late in the morning of 12 July 2016 when two regional passenger trains on a single-track section of the Bari–Barletta railway collided head-on between the towns of Andria and Corato in the Apulia region of southern Italy. Twenty-three people were killed and 54 injured.

title: August 2016 Central Italy earthquake
text: An earthquake, measuring 6.2 ± 0.016 on the moment magnitude scale, hit Central Italy on 24 August 2016 at 03:36:32 CEST. Its epicentre was close to Accumoli, with its hypocentre at a depth of 4 ± 1 km, approximately 75 km (47 mi) southeast of Perugia and 45 km (28 mi) north of L'Aquila, in an area near the borders of the Umbria, Lazio, Abruzzo and Marche regions.

title: earthquake measuring 5.9 on the Richter scale in Central Italy with its epicenter between Castelsantangelo sul Nera, Visso and Ussita.
text: Castelsantangelo sul Nera is a comune in the Province of Macerata in the Italian region of Marche, located about 90 kilometres (56 mi) southwest of Ancona and about 50 kilometres (31 mi) southwest of Macerata. The source of the Nera River is located in the communal territory.

title: Earthquake measuring 6.5 on the Richter scale in Central Italy with its epicenter between Norcia and Preci.
text: Norcia, traditionally known in English by its Latin name of Nursia ( NUR-see-ə, NUR-sh(ee-)ə), is a town and comune (municipality) in the province of Perugia in southeastern Umbria, Italy. Unlike many ancient towns, it is located in a wide plain abutting the Monti Sibillini, a subrange of the Apennines with some of its highest peaks, near the Sordo River, a small stream that eventually flows into the Nera.

title: Prime Minister Matteo Renzi resigns in the hands of the President of the Republic Sergio Mattarella following the defeat in the referendum on 4 December.
text: Matteo Renzi is an Italian politician who served as prime minister of Italy from 2014 to 2016. He has been a senator for Florence since 2018.

title: Paolo Gentiloni assumes the office of President of the Council of Ministers.
text: Paolo Gentiloni Silveri is an Italian politician who was European Commissioner for Economy in the Von der Leyen Commission from 1 December 2019 to 30 November 2024. He had previously served as prime minister of Italy from December 2016 to June 2018.

title: “Est-ce que tu m'aimes?” by Maître Gims
text: "Est-ce que tu m'aimes?" is a song by Congolese singer and rapper Gims (then known as "Maître Gims") from the album Mon cœur avait raison.
listen: Est-ce que tu m'aimes? Maître Gims

title: “Ginza” by J Balvin
text: "Ginza" is a song performed by Colombian singer J Balvin. It was released as the lead single from the singer's studio album Energía on July 17, 2015.

title: “Nessun grado di separazione” by 12 February
text: "Nessun grado di separazione" is a song recorded by Italian singer Francesca Michielin. Written by Michielin herself along with Cheope, Federica Abbate and Fabio Gargiulo; the song was produced by Michele Canova.

title: “7 Years” by Lukas Graham
text: "7 Years" is a song by Danish soul-pop band Lukas Graham from their second studio album, Lukas Graham. The song was released as a digital download on Lukas Forchhammer's 27th birthday by Copenhagen Records.

title: “Faded” by Alan Walker
text: "Faded" is a song by Norwegian DJ and record producer Alan Walker with vocals by Norwegian singer-songwriter Iselin Solheim. A rework of Walker's earlier song "Fade", the song was written by Walker, Jesper Borgen, Mood Melodies, and Gunnar Greve and produced by the former three.

title: “Sofía” by Álvaro Soler
text: "Sofia" is a single by Spanish singer-songwriter Álvaro Soler. The song was released as a separate single after "El mismo sol" and "Agosto".

title: “Vorrei ma non posto” by J-Ax and Fedez
text: "Vorrei ma non posto" is a song by Italian rappers J-Ax and Fedez. It was released on 6 May 2016 as the lead single from their collaborative album Comunisti col Rolex.
listen: Vorrei ma non posto J-Ax and Fedez

title: “Cheap Thrills” by 22 July
text: "Cheap Thrills" is a song by Australian singer and songwriter Sia from her seventh studio album, This Is Acting. It was written by Sia and Greg Kurstin, and produced by Kurstin.

title: “Andiamo a comandare” by 29 July
text: "Andiamo a comandare" is the debut song by Italian singer, producer and filmmaker Fabio Rovazzi. It was written by Rovazzi, Merk & Kremont, Sissa and TwoFingerz.

title: “We Don't Talk Anymore” by Charlie Puth featuring Selena Gomez
text: "We Don't Talk Anymore" is a song by the American singer-songwriter Charlie Puth, featuring vocals from Selena Gomez. It was released on May 24, 2016, as the third single from Puth's debut album, Nine Track Mind.
wiki: We Don't Talk Anymore (Charlie Puth song)
listen: We Don't Talk Anymore Charlie Puth featuring Selena Gomez

title: “Cold Water” by Major Lazer featuring Justin Bieber and MØ
text: "Cold Water" is a song by American electronic dance music production group Major Lazer, featuring vocals from Canadian singer Justin Bieber and Danish singer MØ. The song was released on July 22, 2016, as the lead single from their debut greatest hits album, Major Lazer Essentials. It became Major Lazer's third collaboration with MØ after "Lean On" and "Lost".
listen: Cold Water Major Lazer featuring Justin Bieber and MØ

title: “Let Me Love You” by 23 September
text: "Let Me Love You" is a song recorded by French DJ and record producer DJ Snake featuring vocals from Canadian singer Justin Bieber. The song was released through Interscope Records on 5 August 2016 as the third single from his debut studio album, Encore.
wiki: Let Me Love You (DJ Snake song)

title: “Ninna nanna” by Ghali
text: "Ninna nanna" is the debut single by Italian rapper Ghali, released on 28 October 2016 as the first extract from his first studio album Album. The song peaked at number 1 of the Italian singles' chart and was certified quadruple platinum in Italy, having sold over 200,000 copies.

title: “Potremmo ritornare” by 28 October
text: "Potremmo ritornare" is a pop song written by Italian pop singer Tiziano Ferro. It was released as the first single from his sixth album Il mestiere della vita and achieved success in Italy, where it was certified double platinum by the Federation of the Italian Music Industry.

title: “Assenzio” by J-Ax and Fedez featuring Stash and Levante
text: "Assenzio" is a song by Italian rappers J-Ax and Fedez, with featured vocals by Italian singers Stash and Levante. It was released on 18 November 2016 as the second single from the two rappers' collaborative album Comunisti col Rolex.
listen: Assenzio J-Ax and Fedez featuring Stash and Levante

title: “Tutto molto interessante” by Fabio Rovazzi
text: "Tutto molto interessante" is a song by Italian singer, producer and filmmaker Fabio Rovazzi. It was written by Rovazzi, TwoFingerz, Merk & Kremont, Emanuele Longo and Alessandro Martello.

title: “Rockabye” by 16 December
text: "Rockabye" is a song by British electronic group Clean Bandit featuring Jamaican dancehall rapper Sean Paul and English singer Anne-Marie. It was released on 21 October 2016 and was their first single since Neil Amin-Smith's departure from the group and it served as the lead single from their second studio album, What Is Love?
